last.verdict: Opendoor missed its own margin target and guided to a wider loss next quarter, while inventory and debt ballooned to chase growth.

takeaways.label: Margins and outlook worsen
takeaways.text: Contribution margin fell to 3.3%, below the 4%–4.5% guided and 5.8% last quarter. Q4 profit per home is guided lower, with an Adjusted EBITDA loss of $70–85M versus $31M now.

takeaways.label: Growth bought with inventory
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 12% to $1.02B, short of the 20% guided. Homes bought quadrupled to 4,865, pushing inventory to $2.57B and 7,596 homes. Q4 revenue is guided up at least 40%.

takeaways.label: Debt and losses rising
takeaways.text: Net loss widened to $218M from $90M. About $2.0B of property-backed debt now falls due within a year, against $910M of cash.

takeaways.label: Profit goal slipping
takeaways.text: The target of positive adjusted net income by end of 2026, on a trailing-twelve-month basis, stands, but the company says it is currently behind.

history.verdict: Investors sold on a weak margin outlook despite revenue and cash-burn improvement.

reasons.label: Lower margin outlook
reasons.text: Next-quarter contribution margin guided to 4%–4.5%, below this quarter's 5.8%, blamed on seasonality.

reasons.label: Sales far below last year
reasons.text: Revenue was $883M, down about 44% from a year ago, and below analyst estimates.

reasons.label: Bigger loss, mostly stock pay
reasons.text: Net loss was $162M versus $29M a year ago, driven by about $119M of stock-based pay.
